title: G7 summit opens in France with Ukraine war, new US-Iran agreement on agenda
summary: The memorandum of understanding between the United States and Iran was announced on the eve of the G7 summit in Evian-les-Bains, France, where leaders from some of the world’s wealthiest nations will begin meeting Monday. Gathered in the Alps through Wednesday, they will also discuss the war in Ukraine and global economic imbalances.
